name: SikaCeram Sealing Membrane A
paste:
SIKACERAM® SEALING MEMBRANE A: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: SikaCeram® Sealing Membrane A, December 2025, Version 04.01 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/s/sikaceram-sealingmembranea.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide SikaCeram® Sealing Membrane A where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (December 2025, Version 04.01).
1.2 Product description. SikaCeram® Sealing Membrane A is a flexible waterproofing and decoupling membrane used for waterproofing walls, floors under tiles in wet rooms, swimming pools and balconies. It is suitable for heated floors and has excellent crack bridging properties.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Before tiling for waterproofing and / or decoupling for the following applications:
    - Normal and high loading conditions
    - Commercial / Residential environments
    - Bathrooms
    - Wet area
    - Kitchens
    - Laundry's
    - Spas
    - Showers (private and public)
    - Swimming pools (10 m depth maximum)
    - Balconies
    - Terraces
    - Hospitals
    - Heated floors (Water and electric systems)
    - Overlaying existing, interior, firmly fixed ceramic tiles
    - Interior and exterior use
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.7.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. SikaCeram® Sealing Membrane A
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Flexible waterproofing membrane for wet rooms, swimming pools and balconies below tiling
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Sustainability. VOC emission classification GEV-Emicode EC 1PLUS
2.3 Certificates and test reports.
    - CE Marking and Declaration of Performance to ETA- 20/0677, based on ETAG022 Part 2 - Watertight covering kit for wet room floors and walls based on flexible sheets
    - AS 4858 -2004 Wet area membranes
    - AS 4654.1-2012 Above ground external waterproofing membranes
2.4 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - ETAG022: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Certificates And Test Reports (p.1).
    - AS 4858: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Certificates And Test Reports (p.1).
    - AS 4654.1-2012: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Certificates And Test Reports (p.1).
    - EN ISO 527-3: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Tensile strain at break (p.2); Technical Information > Tensile strength (p.2).
2.5 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Guranteed film thickness vs traditional liquid membrane systems
    - Thickness ~0,5 mm
    - Waterproof
    - Water vapour tightness
    - Decoupling
    - Highly Flexible
    - Crack-bridging
    - Easy to apply
    - Suitable for heated floors
    - Good adhesion to tile adhesives
    - Suitable for pools and spa and other submerged applications protected by a tiling system - Seek Sika specification for these applications.
2.6 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Appearance and colour: Yellow
    - Product declaration: Class III elongation
2.7 Composition.
    | Membrane | Polyethylene |
    | Non-woven | Polypropylene |
2.8 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Mass per area: 285 g/m² (± 20 g/m²)
    - Crack bridging ability: Assessment category 3: Crack width 1,5 mm
    - Reaction to fire: B2
    - Chemical resistance: Resistant to many chemicals. Contact Sika Technical Services for specific information.
    - Resistance to UV exposure: ≥ 450 hours
    - Water-vapour transmission rate: ≥ 50 m
    - Watertightness: ≥ 1,5 bar
    - Service temperature: -30 °C min. / +90 °C max.
2.9 Tensile strength.
    | Longitudinal | 390 N / 50 mm | (≥ 250 N / 50 |
    | mm) |
    | Lateral | 140 N / 50 mm | (≥ 100 N / 50 |
    | mm) |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
    Test method printed: (EN ISO 527-3)
2.10 Tensile strain at break.
    | Longitudinal | 55 % (≥ 35 %) |
    | Lateral | 130 % (≥ 90 %) |
    Test method printed: (EN ISO 527-3)
2.11 System structure. Waterproofing of wet areas, balconies and terraces
    | Porous Primer: | SikaTile 010 Secure Prime |
    | Non-porous Primer: | SikaFloor-14 Prep n Prime |
    | Sheet Membrane System |
    | Sheet Membrane: | SikaCeram® Sealing Membrane A |
    | Flexible bandage | Sika SealTape F |
    | Sika SealTape B |
    | Tiling System | Any Sika manufactured C2S1 classed |
    | flexible cement based tile adhesive |
    | Tile Grout | Any Sika manufactured CG2 clased |
    | tile grout |
    (System build-up table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows. Refer to the data sheet (page 3) for the layout.)
    Submerged Applications, Pools Spas, and Saunas Seek written Sika Specification for submerged applications such as pools or spas.
    Note: Refer to all relevant product datasheets for product limitations and instructions prior to use.
2.12 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 1,0 m wide × 30 m long roll per box. Refer to current price list for packaging variations.
    - Shelf life: 2 years
    - Storage conditions: Product must be horizontally stored in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging dry conditions at temperatures between +5 °C and +35 °C. Always refer to packaging.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (December 2025, Version 04.01) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate quality.
    - The waterproofing membrane is installed by applying it with SikaCeram® Sealing Fix adhesive or using SikaCeram® C2S1 tile adhesive for decoupling.
    - Refer to the individual Product Data Sheets for substrate preparation.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (December 2025, Version 04.01) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Effective thickness: ~0,5 mm
4.3 Mixing ratio. The adhesive used to bond the SikaCeram® Sealing Membrane A system: SikaTile 440 Opti-Cure mixed neat with Lanko Latex 751 Additive. Mixing Ratio:
    - Trowel size 2.6mm V notched trowel for board substrates
    - Trowel size 3.5mm V notched trowel for concrete and screed susbstrates
    | Application Type | SikaTile-440 Opti- | Lanko Latex 751 | Estimated cover- |
    | Cure | age |
    | Rollable | 5.5 - 6.25kg | 5Ltrs | 10m2 |
    | Trowel-able | 7-8kg | 5Ltrs | 9m2 |
    | ▪ Do not dilute the Lanko latex 751 - use neat. |
    | Trowel Application |
    | Pot Life: 1.5 hours (approx) |
    | Mixing Instructions for bonding the SikaCeram® Sealing Membrane A: |
    | 3. Restir the adhesive for an additional 1 minute then the adhesive can be used. |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
    1. Add the Lanko Latex 751 additive to a clean mixing bucket. Slowly add the SikaTile 440 Opti-Cure to the bucket while stirring with an electric mixing drill.
    2. Mix the adhesive to a smooth lump free mixture and allow the mixture to stand or "slake" for 3 minutes.
    4. The adhesive may need restirring during its pot life, do not add any additional Lanko latex 751.
4.4 Equipment.
    - Scissors
    - Razor knife
    - Plastering trowel
4.5 Application.
    - Refer to Mixing Ratio section in this document for Adhesive details.
    - Application of floor wall junctions, changes of plane and corners using Sika SealTape F
    - Apply the adhesive to the substrate junctions with a 100mm roller or v notched trowel. While the adhesive is wet embed the Sika SealTape F in position.
    - Apply addition adhesive to overlap the joins and smooth out with a plastic scraper
    - Application of Pipe Penetrations - Sika SealTape F for PVC fittings, apply a single coat of SikaFloor-14 Prep n Prime and allow to dry.
    - For Metal Fittings, lightly abrade with steel wool and then clean residue with Isopropyl Alcohol and allow to dry.
    - Then apply a single coat of SIkaFloor-14 Prep n Prime and allow to dry.
    - Apply the adhesive around the pipe penetration with a 100mm roller or a V notched trowel and embed the Sika SealTape F around pipe penetrations and flatten out with a plastic scrapper.
    - Application of the SikaCeram® Sealing Membrane A Measure and cut sheet as required with the Utility Knife or Scissors Apply a layer of the adhesive with a roller or V notched trowel to an area that can be covered prior to adhesive skinning (approx 1m2) and embed the SikaCeram® Sealing Membrane A into the adhesive. Immediately fatten the sheet with a plastic scraper. Repeat process by gradually rolling and apply adhesive as required.
    - All sheet joins are to be overlapped by a minimum 50mm and ensure the adhesive covers all sheet joins for a watertight finish. Waterstop Angles, and Terminations Penetration can be terminated onto the pipe penetrations.
    - Prime PVC pipes with SikaFloor-14 Prep n Prime and allow to dry. Apply the adhesive to the primer and install the Sika SealTape F. Control Leak flanges shall be primed with SikaFloor-14 Prep n Prime and allowed to dry prior to bonding sheet terminations or Sika SealTape F with the adhesive Waterstop Angles shall be primed with SikaFloor-14 Prep n Prime and allowed to dry. Bond the Sika SealTape F to Waterstop angles with the adhesive as needed.
4.6 Application - Application Notes.
    - Ensure all sheet joins and tapes etc are overlapped by 50mm.
    - Ensure all sheet joins and over laps are well bonded. If required the adhesive can be skimmed over sheet joins to protect sheet edges.
4.7 Limitations and important considerations.
    - Do not use on roof terraces as the primary waterproofing membrane.
    - Do not apply accessories and membrane beyond the open time of the adhesive.
    - Ensure that the membrane is not damaged during installation.
    - Do not use for any applications not explicitly described in this Product Data Sheet.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Ambient air temperature. +5 °C min. / +35 °C max
5.3 Substrate temperature. +5 °C min. / +35 °C max; For external application in exposed hot sun cover with screed or tile as soon as applicable or cover with a white corflute protection board or similar immediately after installation; Tenting the application area may be required in hot direct sun to avoid high substrate temperatures.
5.4 Test methods printed beside stated values. Each value is as printed in the data sheet with its test method.
    - Tensile strength: Longitudinal | 390 N / 50 mm | (≥ 250 N / 50; mm); Lateral | 140 N / 50 mm | (≥ 100 N / 50; mm) (EN ISO 527-3)
    - Tensile strain at break: Longitudinal | 55 % (≥ 35 %); Lateral | 130 % (≥ 90 %) (EN ISO 527-3)
5.5 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.6 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: SikaCeram® Sealing Membrane A, December 2025, Version 04.01, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/s/sikaceram-sealingmembranea.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
